points.quote: students recognise that they must not use generative AI tools to generate assignments e.g. essays. This is a form of plagiarism with potentially serious consequences.
points.anchor: Recommendations for students on use of Generative AI
points.specific: Students must not use generative AI tools to generate assignments such as essays; this is plagiarism with potentially serious consequences.

points.quote: Generate a whole assignment and simply hand it in – you learn from working and developing an assignment which will be lost if you do not engage.
points.anchor: Using AI to write your assignment
points.specific: Do not generate a whole assignment and hand it in, because the learning from developing it is lost.

points.quote: Assume that AI will evade Turnitin detection
points.anchor: Using AI to write your assignment
points.specific: Do not assume that AI-generated text will evade Turnitin detection.

points.quote: Use it as a starting point for an essay question: to brainstorm, to give you an indication of what’s required, to help you understand the essay question, to clarify concepts that you are having difficulty understanding.
points.anchor: Using AI to write your assignment
points.specific: AI can be used as a starting point for an essay question: to brainstorm, gauge requirements, understand the question and clarify concepts.

points.quote: Copy and paste a paragraph and ask the AI to paraphrase it directly for you.
points.specific: Do not copy and paste a paragraph and ask the AI to paraphrase it for you.

points.quote: Copy references used in an AI generated text without verifying its credibility and reading the original source.
points.specific: Do not copy references from AI-generated text without verifying their credibility and reading the original source.

points.quote: Assume it is 100% accurate (i.e., with a translation); don’t submit a piece of work without checking its accuracy.
points.specific: Do not assume AI is 100% accurate, for example in translation; check accuracy before submitting work.

points.quote: Forget any security/GDPR measures you must adhere to.
points.specific: Do not forget the security and GDPR measures you must follow when working with data.

points.quote: Adhere to guidelines from your convenor/ programme; what are the expectations in its use?
points.specific: Follow guidelines from your convenor or programme on the expected use of AI.

points.quote: Use it (where appropriate and permitted) to analyse data, recognise patterns, and make predictions based on that data.
points.specific: Where appropriate and permitted, AI may be used to analyse data, recognise patterns and make predictions.

points.quote: Submit a response directly generated by AI.
points.specific: Do not submit a response directly generated by AI.

points.quote: Use it as a tool to identify spelling and grammar issues.
points.specific: AI may be used to identify spelling and grammar issues.

points.quote: Studiosity is a free personal learning service that is available to all students enrolled at SOAS.
points.specific: Studiosity is a free personal learning service available to all enrolled SOAS students.

points.quote: Ask AI to check the referencing for you and identify weak areas to develop – it can be a useful tool for feedback.
points.specific: Asking AI to check referencing and identify weak areas is presented as a useful feedback tool.
